description.plain: Innate: Briar's basic attacks on-hit and abilities inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, stacking up to 5 times and dealing 25% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed deals 10 – 50 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) total physical damage and heals Briar for 2.5 – 12.5 (based on level) (+ 12.5% bonus AD) over the duration, increased by 2.5 – 12.5 (based on level) (+ 12.5% bonus AD) and 0.63 – 3.13 (based on level) (+ 3.125% bonus AD) for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of 20 – 100 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) total physical damage and 5 – 25 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) over the duration. If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% of the remaining bleed damage.

description2.plain: Briar has no base health regeneration, but she increases healing from all sources by 0% – 40% (based on missing health) (+ 0% – 2.5% (based on missing health) per 100 bonus health).

blurb.plain: Innate: Briar has no base health regeneration but she gains increased healing from other sources based on her missing health.

blurb2.plain: Innate: Briar's basic attacks on-hit and abilities inflict a bleed on the target for a few seconds, which may stack up to 5 times. For each stack, the target is dealt physical damage and Briar heals for a portion of it.

blurb3.plain: If a target affected by her bleed dies, Briar heals for the remaining amount.

params.notes:
* ''Head Rush'' can be cast on [[jungle plants]], {{tip|wards}}, and {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}.
** It cannot be cast on {{tip|structures}}.
* ''Head Rush'' does not force the target's armor and magic resistance to update immediately outside of the {{tt|natural stat update cycle|once every 0.25 seconds}}, meaning its damage will typically still be mitigated by the unreduced armor value.
* ''Head Rush's'' damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
* ''Head Rush'' is a non-following dash.
** It picks its dash destination ~100 units in front of enemy targets, 75 units in front of enemy targets when already very close to them, 75 units in front of allied targets. 
** If already within 75 units of her target, she dashes to her current location, which takes 0 time but still triggers dash effects such as {{ri|Sudden Impact}}.
<!-- Blurb -->

params.notes:
* ''Blood Frenzy'' acquires targets regardless of if they are visible or not.
** This does not apply to {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} targets.
** It cannot acquire {{tip|ward|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], or structures however.
* The target priority shift from casting {{ai|Q|Briar}} on a minion or monster will occur even if the dash is interrupted.
* If the main attack {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, the cleave damage will do so as well.
* '''Briar''' uses {{tip|Frenzy}} as a [[Ability resource#Frenzy|resource]] to indicate the remaining duration of the frenzy, in seconds.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Briar''' is in her frenzy:
** While in the frenzy, '''Briar''' cannot control her movement nor declare who she attacks. She will automatically acquire a nearby enemy as her attack target based on a priority system, becoming ''forced'' to basic attack the target and consequently move into her attack range of them to do so.
*** {{tip|Disarming crowd control}} as well as any other lockout that would disable basic attacking will disable the forced attacks.
*** {{tip|Forced action}} crowd control will cause her forced attacks to be either overridden or disabled, depending on the actions being forced by the debuff.

params.notes:
* {{Pending for test}} The dash is considered an ability activation for the purposes of {{ii|Sheen}} and {{cai|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}.
* '''Briar''' will track the target with the {{tip|dash}} if they change locations.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* '''Briar''' lands 100 units in front of her target at the end of the dash.
* '''Briar''' will not initiate the second cast if she is being {{tip|suppression|suppressed}}, is under {{tip|resurrection}}, or is in the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} when her target is hit by the missile in the normal realm.
** Since ''Certain Death'' cleanses herself from all crowd control when the first cast hits, she will be able to start the second cast due to removing the suppression effect.
* '''Briar''' will still dash to the target even if they die before she reaches them.
* '''Briar''' will transition from having {{tip|cc-immune|total crowd control immunity}} during the cast time of the dash, to having {{tip|displacement immunity}} during the dash.
* '''Briar''' will place herself onto the ground and interrupt {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting her upon starting the second cast time.
* ''Hematomania's'' targeting priorities differ slightly from that of ''{{ais|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'':
** She will prioritize the marked target regardless of range and over all other units as long as it can be attacked.
*** If the marked target is not available, then she shifts her priority to the nearest other champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit in a global radius.
* Starting the second cast interrupts any spells that '''Briar''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}.
* The mark will expire if ''Hematomania's'' buff is dispelled.
* Casting ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' will not grant any additional bonuses nor will it override ''Hematomania's'' effects.
** Gaining ''Hematomania'' while ''Blood Frenzy'' is active will override the previous buff.
** Casting  ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' does allow the use of ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''. However, both ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'''s effects and the ability to use ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}'' are immediately interrupted upon exiting ''Hematomania''.
* The {{tip|disrupt}} is 'wrapped' into a status effect that causes the affected champion to display the "{{tip|silence|Silenced}}" UI on their [[Health bar#Disabled state|health bar]] for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, without actually applying the disabling effects of the {{tip|silence}} crowd control type (functions as an indicator of the target becoming ''disrupted''). This however ensures that the ''disrupt'' is also prevented by effects that would negate {{tip|silence|silences}} (such as {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}).
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate at the end of ''Certain Death's'' initial cast time. If the missile hits a target, the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the dash.

description.plain: Active: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith in the target direction, briefly granting sight of its surroundings as it travels and marking the first enemy champion hit as her prey. The mark's application disrupts the target's ongoing channels. While the target is marked, they are revealed.

description2.plain: If a target is hit, Briar cleanses herself from all crowd control and becomes immune to them over a cast time, afterwards dashing to them with displacement immunity. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals magic damage to them and nearby enemies and fears all non-marked targets for 1.5 seconds, during which they are slowed by 35%. She then enters a state of Hematomania.

description3.plain: Hematomania: Briar gains all effects of Blood Frenzy as well as bonus armor and bonus magic resistance equal to 20% AD, life steal, and additional bonus movement speed.

description4.plain: While in the empowered frenzy, Briar prioritizes attacking the marked target over all other units and regardless of range. If that target becomes invalid, she will shift back to her normal targeting priority until the marked target can be attacked again. Hematomania lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including Briar's or the target's death.

description5.plain: Casting Chilling Scream removes the target's mark and ends Hematomania early. Head Rush cast does not shift her targeting priority during Hematomania.

blurb.plain: Active: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith a large distance toward the target direction which marks the first enemy champion hit and reveals them.

blurb2.plain: If a target is hit, Briar destroys her pillory and dashes to them. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion that deals magic damage to the marked champion and enemies around them, and also fears all non-marked enemies. Briar then enters Hematomania.

blurb3.plain: Hematomania: Briar gains all effects of Blood Frenzy against the marked target as well as bonus armor, bonus magic resistance, life steal, and additional bonus movement speed. Hematomania lasts until she or the marked target dies.

blurb4.plain: Briar can cast Chilling Scream to end Hematomania early.
